art.title: Winter Landscape with Ice Skaters
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons
art.story: The whole village is out on the frozen river: skaters young and old, couples arm in arm, a ship stuck fast with its mast in the air, and, on the far left, someone who has fallen through a hole. Snow lies on the cottages, birds sit in the bare branches, and a mill stands quiet in the haze. Winters were bitterly cold in those years. Hendrick Avercamp could neither hear nor speak, and filled his pictures with hundreds of tiny stories to find.
